sanskrit_verse: सहस्रशीर्षाजापी तु मुच्यते गुरुतल्पगः / गौर् देया कर्मणो 'स्यान्ते पृथग् एभिः पयस्विनी //
transliteration: sahasraśīrṣājāpī tu mucyate gurutalpagaḥ / gaur deyā karmaṇo 'syānte pṛthag ebhiḥ payasvinī //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who performs the thousand-headed chant is liberated through the guru's bed; a cow, milk-giving and distinct, shall be given at the conclusion of this act.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from realized spiritual instruction
Causation aligns with ritual completion and conscious intent
Capacity-based responsibility arises upon initiation into sacred practice
Restoration occurs through prescribed offering and energetic completion
Consciousness alignment manifests via disciplined repetition and guru-disciple continuity
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent performs sahasraśīrṣa japa THEN liberation status granted under guru-lineage validation
IF ritual concludes THEN specific asset (cow) MUST be transferred to designated recipient
IF asset transfer omits specified traits (milk-giving, distinct) THEN transaction invalid
IF guru-lineage unverified THEN no karmic discharge recorded
IF completion process interrupted THEN restart required with full restitution protocol
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters involving spiritual inheritances or Vedic compliance claims, the court must verify lineage authenticity and precise execution of scriptural directives. Responsibility lies not in moral fault but in capacity to fulfill dharma-transaction accurately.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through uninterrupted transmission from guru to disciple. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures that each action leads sequentially to purification and release. Responsibility is proportional to initiation level. There is no punitive element—only realignment of consciousness through correct performance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Reconnect petitioner with qualified guru for validation
Complete interrupted ritual with supervised precision
Transfer specified cow with verified traits to rightful receiver
Document energetic completion in akashic registry
Restore participant’s spiritual credit through guided repetition
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law executes pure consciousness, restores integrity without punishment, and affirms that reality responds solely to truthful completion.
